newsitem.title: INDIA: India MMTC to sell independence medallions in gold.
newsitem.headline: India MMTC to sell independence medallions in gold.

text.p: Indian Commerce Minister Bolla Buli Ramaiah on Friday released a gold medallion designed by state-owned trading house MMTC Ltd to mark 50 years of India's independence from colonial British rule.
While one side of the medallion has a special independence anniversary logo designed by the government, the other shows India's map along with MMTC's logo.
The medallions made in 24-carat gold weigh 10 grams each, the statement said.
The "Freedom Medallion" will be sold in the Indian market at 5,800 rupees and in the international market at $165 each, MMTC said. ($1=35.7 rupees)
